prompt: The sterile hospital ward features two beds separated by a privacy curtain. In the left bed, an elderly patient in a blue gown sits up, holding a clear plastic cup of water offered by a nurse in white scrubs standing beside the bed. The nurse smiles gently, supporting the patient's back with one hand. On the right bed, a child in pajamas plays with a teddy bear, while a doctor in a white coat kneels beside the bed, checking a stethoscope against the child's chest. An IV stand with a hanging bag stands between the beds in the center foreground. A wheelchair is parked near the foot of the left bed. A monitor displaying vital signs glows softly on a wall mount in the background. A tray with medical supplies rests on a rolling cart near the doctor. Fluorescent ceiling lights provide even, clinical illumination, casting minimal shadows. The floor is polished linoleum, reflecting the overhead lights. The atmosphere is calm and professional. The style is a photorealistic photo.
